title: Follow the Snakes to the Coiled Isle for New Adventures
summary: Venture beyond the mists of the Coiled Isle as the fog lifts from the island off Zul’Aman’s eastern coast. Join Zul’jarra in her pursuit of Zul’jan while exploring the Vaults of Atal’Utek, facing Curse Surges, unlocking the powers of the Altar of Corrosion, and discovering the treasures hidden within the isle’s cursed waters.

title: Get Ready for a Showdown in August’s Trading Post

title: Curse of Ula’tek: Raid Finder Wing 3 Now Live!

Awakened by Zul’jan’s actions, this ancient creature of hatred, corruption, and venom waits at the heart of a new eight-boss raid dungeon, where champions will battle through her venomous brood before facing Ula’tek herself.

title: Keep Track of Potions, Trinkets and More with New User Interface Updates
summary: Curse of Ula’tek brings new user interface updates to help you keep track of cooldowns, consumables, and key combat information. Track potions and trinkets in the Cooldown Manager, ping key spell and health information to your party, and adjust Raid Frames to keep the healing effects you rely on front and center.

title: Midnight Season 2 is Now Live!
summary: Steel your resolve, gather your allies, and descend into the darkness in Midnight Season 2. Brave the Venomous Abyss, conquer the new Mythic+ rotation, prove your mettle in PvP, delve deeper for dangerous rewards, and stalk deadly new Prey across the Coiled Isle.

title: Curse of Ula’tek Now live! Journey to the Coiled Isle.
summary: Continue the Midnight campaign as the Curse of Ula’tek content update opens the way to the Coiled Isle, where venomous foes, cursed waters, and long-buried secrets await. Take on new adventures, including the Venomous Abyss raid, Altar of Fangs dungeon, new Delves, Season 2 challenges, housing updates, and more.

title: Twitch Drop Now Live! Get the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb Transmog
summary: Watch any eligible World of Warcraft stream on Twitch.tv from 11 August at 18:00 BST until 8 September at 18:00 BST to claim the Ensemble: Sorcerer's Grassy Garb transmog.

summary: Answer the call to a reimagined Azeroth with World of Warcraft: Forever. Pre-purchase the Skyborne Heroic Pack, Skyborne Epic Pack, or Warcraft Forever Collection on the Battle.net Shop to unlock upgrade benefits, prepare for beta, and bring a friend along with Invite-A-Friend Launch Codes when it goes live.

title: Wage War Once More with Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom
summary: Return to the battlefields that shaped Azeroth with Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom, an all-new campaign that bridges the story from The Frozen Throne to the first days of World of Warcraft. Purchase the Forsaken Kingdom campaign on the Battle.net Shop on its own or choose from additional options that include Warcraft III: Reforged, the Forsaken Kingdom combo, and the Warcraft Forever Collection.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever GPU Requirements
summary: When World of Warcraft: Forever launches GPUs based on certain older graphics architectures that fall well below the game's minimum hardware requirements will no longer be supported. The vast majority of World of Warcraft players already use compatible hardware, and this change will allow us to support the game’s updated visual look while providing a more consistent experience for players.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives — Priest and Warrior
summary: Priests and Warriors are next in our World of Warcraft: Forever class deep dives, with updates that build on the roles, rhythms, and class-defining tools players know. This look covers new and adjusted baseline abilities, refreshed racial Priest spells, Rage and stance updates for Warriors, and talent changes across Discipline, Holy, Shadow, Arms, Fury, and Protection.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Class Deep Dives — Hunter and Druid
summary: Answer the call of the wild and take on nature’s many forms in World of Warcraft: Forever. We’re sharing Development Team insights on Hunter and Druid, including how these classes are evolving through talent updates, class-defining abilities, and new ways to play.

title: Choose Your Ruleset in World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is taking a new approach to where and how players begin their journey. Instead of choosing from a long list of realms, players will select a ruleset—Normal, PvP, Roleplaying, or Hardcore—that matches how they want to experience Azeroth. Each option operates as its own large ecosystem for grouping, dungeons, raids, and community, with Hardcore joining the available lineup sometime after launch.

title: WoW: Forever Meet the New Skyborne
summary: The Skyborne—also known as the shen’dorei, or hidden people—are a new playable race in World of Warcraft: Forever. Their journey begins on Zephras Isle, a level 1–12 starting experience that blends classic Warcraft aesthetics with elemental architecture and a story shaped by wind and ancestry. At character creation, you’ll choose whether your Skyborne joins the proud Horde or the noble Alliance.

title: Carve a New Path with World of Warcraft: Forever
summary: Catch up on everything announced for World of Warcraft: Forever during BlizzCon, including a first look at the next chapter for Azeroth and the adventures waiting on the horizon.

title: Tales Take a Dark Turn in Midnight’s Talebound
summary: Step into Midnight’s Talebound, a PvE action RPG game mode where macabre stories come to life. Venture solo or with friends through eerie tales filled with enemies, bosses, puzzles, treasure, relics, and cosmetic rewards as you confront the terrors waiting beyond Quillgrave.

title: Raise Your Stein! Brewfest Returns with Battle-Brewed Rewards
summary: Eat delicious food, drink bountiful beverages, ride rams around barrels of apples, and earn stout rewards! Brewfest has arrived, and you can enjoy all that and more from 20 September to 6 October.

You can also look ahead to October’s Trading Post and catch up on the Brewfest in-game holiday, what’s happening in the WoW Portal Room, and more in WoW Weekly.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever What’s Next Panel Recap
summary: For years, players have wondered what new adventures could still unfold in original Azeroth. During the What’s Next panel, Senior Game Director Ion Hazzikostas, Lead Classic Designer Tim Jones, Lead Software Engineer Nora Mills, and Associate Production Director Clay Stone shared how that dream is taking shape in World of Warcraft: Forever, from new regions and dungeons to raids, systems, the new playable Skyborne race, and the road ahead.

title: World of Warcraft: Forever Found Photos Panel Recap
summary: Senior Game Designer Josh Greenfield and Lead Content Designer Evan Lee shared how original Azeroth’s forgotten corners, unfinished threads, and long-held player memories helped inspire World of Warcraft: Forever. Learn how the team is expanding the level 1–60 experience with reimagined regions, quests, characters, locations, and stories that build on original Azeroth.

title: The World of Warcraft: Forever Beta Now Live
summary: The World of Warcraft: Forever beta begins September 17 and is available through October 21. Opt in for a chance to join testing, or gain beta access by purchasing eligible World of Warcraft: Forever bundles, then share your feedback as we prepare for launch on November 4 at 3:00 p.m. PST.

title: Create a Name of Your Own in WoW: Forever
summary: In World of Warcraft: Forever, every character name is an opportunity to express yourself and establish your identity in Azeroth. With the addition of two names, players have more room to create something personal while keeping each full name unique within a region. That means you may still be able to use the same first name as another character, but your complete two-name combination is unique to you.
